description: Signaleringskaart Aardgas (traces) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De signaleringskaart aardgas (traces) signaleert de locaties van aardgasleidingen die ouder zijn dan 30 jaar, of als 'te vervangen' zijn geclassificeerd. De categorie 'te vervangen' is gebaseerd op materiaalsoorten zoals asbest en grijs gietijzer waarvan collectief is afgesproken dat deze verwijderd moeten worden. De aardgasleidingen zijn op buurtniveau (CBS) geagreggeerd. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are gasleidingen, infrastructuur, leidingen. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, JSON, PNG, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
